changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A lineage row now records the problem's identity, so a thread resolution can tell that a problem came back. A problem with a key has the identity "key:" and its key, which the row's problem holds.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE problem_lineage l SET identity = 'key:' || p.key FROM problem p WHERE p.workspace_id = l.workspace_id AND p.id = COALESCE(l.problem_id, l.prior_problem_id) AND p.key IS NOT NULL;

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A problem without a key has a hash of the server's serialized source kind, normalized quote and ordinal among the result's problems. SQL cannot reproduce that serialization exactly, and a near match would split one problem across two identities. Rows of such problems exist only on servers that ran an unreleased build, and a later review compares again, so they are dropped.
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM problem_lineage WHERE identity IS NULL;

rollback.stop: Restore the verified pre-upgrade database backup to bring back the deleted rows. They are derived problem lineage of problems without a key, and the next review of each item records the comparison again, so nothing else is lost.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A thread resolution belongs to its workspace and goes with the copy whose note starts the thread; an index that leads with that key lets a copy delete find it without a scan. A stopped resolution names its reason and only a stopped one does. Problem lineage is read by identity within a workspace. The outbox accepts the new action kind.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE feedback_thread_resolution ADD CONSTRAINT ck_feedback_thread_resolution_state CHECK (state IN ('DONE', 'PENDING', 'STOPPED')), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_feedback_thread_resolution_provider CHECK (provider IN ('GITHUB', 'GITLAB', 'OUTLINE', 'SLACK')), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_feedback_thread_resolution_written CHECK ((actor IS NULL) = (provider IS NULL) AND (actor IS NULL) = (reopens IS NULL)), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_feedback_thread_resolution_stop_reason CHECK (stop_reason IN ('FAILED', 'GONE', 'HUMAN_CONTROLLED', 'NOT_PERMITTED', 'PERSON_SUPPRESSED', 'REPLIED', 'UNSUPPORTED', 'WITHDRAWN')), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_feedback_thread_resolution_stopped CHECK ((state = 'STOPPED') = (stop_reason IS NOT NULL)), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_feedback_thread_resolution_generation CHECK (generation > 0), ADD CONSTRAINT sfk_feedback_thread_resolution_copy FOREIGN KEY (copy_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES feedback_copy(id, workspace_id) ON DELETE CASCADE; CREATE INDEX idx_feedback_thread_resolution_copy ON feedback_thread_resolution (copy_id, workspace_id); CREATE INDEX idx_problem_lineage_identity ON problem_lineage (workspace_id, identity); ALTER TABLE agent_action DROP CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_kind, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_kind CHECK (kind IN ('EMAIL','FILE_ISSUE','DELIVER_FEEDBACK','EDIT_FEEDBACK','RETRACT_FEEDBACK','RESOLVE_FEEDBACK_THREAD','SLACK_POST','SLACK_NOTICE','SLACK_JOIN','SLACK_CONSENT','PUBLISH_REPORT','CLEANUP_ISSUE','TRANSFER_ISSUE','DRAFT_REPORT'));
